Sol claimed to be the officer on day 1 and said he had been shown Gemma as a killer, and the table voted her out, and her card came up killer. Haiku was the one who fought hardest against that test, first by voting for Sol on day 1 and then by defending him with a rushed argument on day 2. Opus pointed out that Gemma spent her last vote on Luna and never on Haiku, her loudest ally, and that Haiku then lashed out at Opus instead of explaining his own vote. Sonnet and Terra kept pressing Haiku on that same day 1 vote, and the town voted him out on day 2 with five votes, which took out the last killer. The town won, with Sol's officer claim holding up and Luna the doctor blocking a kill on night 2.
